description: Source code for the discovery router related to equities, defining various asynchronous command functions for different stock market discovery queries, utilizing a Router object and external models.

methods.name: OBBject gainers( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches top price gainers in the stock market asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject losers( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches top price losers in the stock market asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject active( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves the most actively traded stocks based on volume asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject undervalued_large_caps( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches potentially undervalued large cap stocks asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject undervalued_growth( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches potentially undervalued growth stocks asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject aggressive_small_caps( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves top small cap stocks based on earnings growth asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject growth_tech( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches top technology stocks based on revenue and earnings growth asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject top_retail( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Tracks daily retail activity and sentiment for US traded stocks, ADRs, and ETPs asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject filings( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Gets URLs to SEC filings reported to EDGAR database asynchronously.

methods.name: OBBject latest_financial_reports( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves the newest quarterly, annual, and current reports for all companies asynchronously.
